limitations: Exploratory paired speaker bootstrap; multiple comparisons unadjusted
Accelerated acoustic replay; warm CPU generation, no UI/insertion or stop-to-review latency
Natural read speech and synthetic mixed-language stress fixtures; no spontaneous speech or independent semantic ratings
Audio IPA comes from unfine-tuned Allosaurus uni2005; single phone path, no tone-aware pinyin acoustic model
No real N-best exposed by selected ASR; no candidate reranking claim
No protected-span annotations in this corpus; error-rate and corruption proxies do not prove intent preservation
